release_notes: Fixes Build 47 opening on the legacy Quizzes page instead of the new Factburst Autopilot home.
Autopilot shell activation now waits for the app's quiz-first navigation rebuild instead of looking for the Dashboard button that the rebuild removes.
The compact Autopilot, Create, Performance, Library, Advanced and Settings navigation is anchored to the stable Quizzes route after startup.
A startup activation guard retries until the rebuilt navigation is ready, then selects the Autopilot home automatically.
The shell fix is structural and no longer depends on the legacy Dashboard label, preventing the same startup-order failure when navigation sections change.
All Build 47 recovery and schedule Auto-fill features remain unchanged.
